summary: RC1 Wave 2 regression: backend smoke (5/5 endpoints) PASSED; the react-dom-19 crash flagged in the review is FIXED on the marketing home at 1440px — NO LogBox / 'Failed to set an indexed property' / 'Uncaught Error' overlay. Admin portal desktop sidebar + mobile tab bar behavior verified end-to-end (login, nav item active state, users navigation, logout). Auth cards centered on desktop (login 412px, register 452px). Newsletter subscribe posts to /api/newsletter/subscribe → 200. BUT: the /drivers URL resolves to app/(admin)/drivers.tsx instead of app/(marketing)/drivers.tsx (route-group collision), so hitting the marketing 'Drivers' link surfaces a distinct 'Missing token' Uncaught-Error LogBox overlay. This is a critical, user-visible regression path (independent of the react-dom-19 fix).

ui_bugs.issue: Both /(admin)/drivers.tsx and /(marketing)/drivers.tsx exist. Because expo-router strips group parens, the URL '/drivers' is ambiguous and resolves to the admin file (loaded via src/api/client.ts fetch that requires a token). Result: red LogBox overlay 'Uncaught Error — Missing token' appears when an unauthenticated visitor clicks the header 'Drivers' link. Marketing 'Drivers' page is effectively unreachable.

Console warning: 'No route named "index" exists in nested children'. Indicates the app/_layout.tsx Stack is trying to declare or default-navigate to a screen named 'index' at the root level that does not exist (only route groups + settings/driver-profile exist at root). Non-blocking but noisy on every page load.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking the 'Drivers' link in the marketing header opens the admin drivers screen which calls /api/admin/drivers without a JWT and throws in src/api/client.ts:43 → shown as a red LogBox overlay.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings on every page: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated in a future pass.

action_items: Fix /drivers route collision. Options: (a) rename app/(admin)/drivers.tsx to a distinct URL (e.g. app/(admin)/manage-drivers.tsx and update SideRail admin nav 'Drivers' href to '/(admin)/manage-drivers'), or (b) rename app/(marketing)/drivers.tsx to /for-drivers and update marketing nav links. Prefer option (a) to keep the public URL /drivers marketing-facing (SEO-friendly).

Also audit for other cross-group URL collisions (customer /profile vs driver /profile vs admin /profile all resolve to /profile — currently masked because auth gating steers each role to their group, but the same 'first group wins' rule may bite again).
Investigate the 'No route named "index" exists in nested children' Stack warning in app/_layout.tsx — either add a placeholder <Stack.Screen name="index" /> or drop the reference.
Optional cleanup: migrate deprecated shadow* / pointerEvents style props to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents (react-native-web deprecation warnings).
critical_code_review_comments: SideRail at src/components/portal/SideRail.tsx uses router.push() instead of Link asChild (as noted in the Wave 2 changelog) — confirmed working, no react-dom-19 regressions observed at 1440px.
AdminTabs (_layout.tsx) hides the tab bar via `tabBar={isWebDesktop ? () => null : undefined}` — verified: [role=tablist] absent at 1440×900 and present at 390×844.
usePortalLayout hook correctly toggles isWebDesktop at width>=1024 in the browsers I tested.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test customer accounts via /api/auth/register (test_wave2_*@example.com) and one newsletter subscription (newsletter_*@example.com). Data prefixed for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 2 react-dom-19 fix confirmed working on marketing / at 1440×900 — no LogBox overlay. Admin portal sidebar+tab responsiveness verified. Register card 452px, Login card 412px. Backend smoke suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_wave2_smoke.py (5 tests, all green). Outstanding issue for main agent: /drivers URL collides between (admin) and (marketing) groups — resolves to (admin) and crashes for unauthenticated users. After main agent renames one of the routes, retest by (1) unauth GET /drivers should render marketing content (no LogBox), (2) logged-in admin sidebar 'Drivers' should still navigate to the admin driver list. Also worth double-checking (customer|driver|admin)/profile similarly do not collide with any marketing/settings path.
rca_of_issue: REPRO for /drivers crash: open incognito → https://cargo-one-preview.preview.emergentagent.com/drivers → red LogBox 'Uncaught Error — Missing token' at src/api/client.ts:43, call stack shows 'load app/(admin)/drivers.tsx:18:20'. Root cause: expo-router route groups ('(admin)', '(marketing)') are stripped from the URL, so both app/(admin)/drivers.tsx and app/(marketing)/drivers.tsx claim '/drivers' — expo-router picks the first alphabetically ('(admin)'). Fix by renaming one of the two files so their public URLs differ.
